svg.title: Without three largest sessions, two endpoints reverse sign
svg.desc: Session-level sensitivity of cumulative forecast-loss differences, with full-window bounds and three-session removal paths.
svg.text: Without three largest sessions, two endpoints reverse sign
No full-window endpoint reaches 61% of its own bound
Three largest absolute sessions removed in pale paths
Three largest absolute sessions removed in pale paths
All six endpoints finish below 61% of their own full-window bound.
Diagonal bounds scale a full-window per-session threshold by scored sessions elapsed; they are not prefix-specific inference.
Pale paths set each model's three largest absolute session contributions to zero; this is a descriptive sensitivity check.
